Padded blocks

INSIDE-MARKER first padded paragraph, and the sentence continues long enough that the line wraps once, then wraps again, and finally stops right here.

NESTED-MARKER paragraph inside a nested container inside the padded one, long enough to wrap across at least two full lines before it ends.

AFTER-CLOSE-MARKER text flowing after the nested container closed, still inside the padded one.

OUTSIDE-MARKER paragraph following the padded container close, back at the left margin.
